repairs.description: White argues that a Gospel’s theological purpose remains compatible with historical accuracy: Luke could give Theophilus certainty without revising events or inventing myths.
repairs.rationale: Restores a complete grammatical description that faithfully combines White’s proposition with his stated inference from Luke’s purpose.

repairs.description: White argues that judgments of historical authenticity depend on worldview: if God can enter creation and reveal himself, objective revelation in history is possible.
repairs.rationale: Restores a complete grammatical description that accurately states White’s worldview condition and its implication for objective historical revelation.
